classification.difficultyReason: The two required right triangles are explicitly identified before the angle calculation.

content.prompt: The cube shown here has a side length of $2\text{ m}$.

spec.description: Unshaded cube with black ordinary edges and equal-length marks. Red dashed construction diagonals distinguish AC and AD from cube edges. Source decorative blue outlines are converted to black.
spec.mathematics: AB = BC = CD = 2 m. AC is the base diagonal; AD is the space diagonal. Front, right and top faces are visible; the other three edges meeting the rear lower left vertex are hidden.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and construction diagonals are visible.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Draw the right-angled triangle $\triangle ABC$ and label all the side lengths. Answer using exact values.

answer.short: $AB=BC=2\text{ m}$; $AC=2\sqrt2\text{ m}$, with a right angle at $B$.

spec.mathematics: Right angle at B; AB = BC = 2 m; AC = 2√2 m.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Draw the right-angled triangle $\triangle ACD$ and label all the side lengths. Answer using exact values.

answer.short: $AC=2\sqrt2\text{ m}$; $CD=2\text{ m}$; $AD=2\sqrt3\text{ m}$, with a right angle at $C$.

spec.mathematics: Right angle at C; AC = 2√2 m; CD = 2 m; AD = 2√3 m.
